title: Implement authenticated push subscription and device routes
acceptance_criteria: PUT /v1/devices/:id/push accepts only an authenticated owner and validates a bounded HTTPS endpoint plus p256dh/auth subscription keys.
A valid push request upserts exactly one subscription for the device and never stores the full browser PushSubscription object or unrelated client data.
GET /v1/devices/:id returns minimal device/subscription status without returning a bearer token, endpoint secret, or VAPID private key.
DELETE /v1/devices/:id revokes the device and removes its subscription; invalid input and unauthorized access are rejected with stable non-sensitive errors.
completion_summary: Implemented authenticated owner-only push registration, minimal device status, secure validation, and atomic revoke cleanup with focused tests.
